_comment: The Lua release the Windows driver's export host (ergopti_lua_export.c) is built from, the single source for tools/build/build_windows_lua_export.ps1 (cl.exe, the shipped ergopti_lua_export.exe) and tools/build/build-lua-export-host.cjs (gcc, the local proof). url and sha256 pin the official lua.org archive; archive_root is its top folder; sources are the files of its src folder the host links, in order: the core and only the base, string, table, math and utf8 libraries, never liolib, loslib, ldblib, loadlib, lcorolib, linit, lua or luac. license_file is the committed copy of the MIT notice at the end of src/lua.h, which the build checks against the archive. The host's source_fingerprint is the SHA-256 of the text '<sha256>\n<SHA-256 of ergopti_lua_export.c>\n'.
